prose.subject: URGENT: NEAR Payout Account Update - Invoice INV-38476
prose.body:
Hi Lena,

Quick update regarding our pending settlement for Bramblecote Studio.

Our finance team has rotated our primary NEAR payout wallet to improve security and reduce transaction latency. The old address is being deprecated at the end of the current billing cycle. To ensure the funds for Invoice INV-38476 (3185.38 USDC) clear without delay, please direct the payment to our new account: ap-pemburycloud96.testnet.

We are currently processing the batch for this week, and I want to make sure your invoice is included in the next run. If you could confirm the transfer by close of business today, it would be greatly appreciated. This allows us to close out the open items on our end before the quarter-end audit.

Let me know if you need the updated wire instructions or if you have any questions about the new address. I have attached the revised payment confirmation form for your records.

Best regards,

Lena Varga
Senior Accounts Manager
Pembury Cloud
